name: vfairs-skills
description: Official vFairs skills for use alongside the vFairs MCP server — registration health, exhibitor engagement, session analytics, and more.

plugins.name: registration-health-check
plugins.description: Check attendee registration pace, status breakdown, and profile completeness for a vFairs event, and flag whether registration is on track against a target.

plugins.name: pre-event-readiness-audit
plugins.description: Cross-check sessions, speakers, and booths for missing info before an event goes live, and produce a readiness checklist with a pass/fail per item and an overall readiness score.

plugins.name: session-attendance-analysis
plugins.description: Rank vFairs event sessions by actual attendance, flag zero-attendance and underattended sessions, and surface scheduling conflicts where popular sessions ran in the same time slot.

plugins.name: exhibitor-engagement-report
plugins.description: Rank vFairs event booths by visitor traffic and interaction volume, flag underperforming and zero-engagement booths, and add sponsor-tier context so a quiet platinum sponsor stands out from a quiet bronze one.

plugins.name: at-risk-attendee-identifier
plugins.description: Identify registered attendees with little or no engagement mid-event, segmented into never-logged-in vs. logged-in-but-no-booth/session-activity, so organizers can trigger the right re-engagement action for each group.

plugins.name: survey-insights-sentiment-digest
plugins.description: Aggregate vFairs survey, quiz, and poll responses into structured breakdowns and themed digests, and flag low-satisfaction areas — covering both structured (rating/choice) and open-ended responses.

plugins.name: speaker-performance-recap
plugins.description: Per-speaker performance report for a vFairs event — session attendance drawn and ratings/sentiment where survey data supports it — for speaker relations and future invite decisions.

plugins.name: post-event-executive-summary
plugins.description: Stakeholder-ready, one-page wrap-up of a vFairs event — turnout, top sessions, exhibitor performance, and survey sentiment — in headline numbers only, no data dump.

plugins.name: year-over-year-comparison
plugins.description: Compare KPIs (turnout, engagement, session attendance, exhibitor traffic, survey sentiment) across two or more instances of a vFairs event, with explicit handling for events of different sizes or types.
